state.request: Fix intermittent Windows stale-lock recovery EPERM so concurrent clients recover safely and CI is deterministic.

evidence.summary: The concurrent stale-lock recovery, cleanup, and superseded-owner tests passed in 10 consecutive local stress runs and in GitHub Actions run 30461861341.
The classifier test proves Windows EPERM and EACCES are retryable, and the real windows-latest job passed after the previously observed EPERM failure.
The classifier rejects non-Windows permission errors and unexpected codes, while the newer-owner protection test confirms compare-before-remove safety remains intact.

Criterion and diff review found the retry set narrow, Windows-specific, and bounded by the existing deadline. Stale inspection now avoids unbounded spinning, while ownership tokens, inode/device comparison, recovery serialization, heartbeat, and compare-before-remove cleanup remain unchanged.
